subject: Pilot consumption 'gamma' — monthly spend & procurement ladder

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot consumption 'gamma' — quick post-call recap + ask

Kai — thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the two asks we talked about: 

1) Usage profile: you mentioned a planned pilot that will run 3 user-facing features (search summarization, chat assistance, and email triage) over a 90-day window. Your initial estimate was ~12–18M tokens/month once the pilot hits steady state (week 3–4).

2) Unit economics you're targeting: you said finance prefers to see target pricing at or below $35 / 1M tokens for pilot phase to greenlight a PO; above that they require a stronger commit.

3) Procurement gates: procurement indicated anything above a $15k monthly expected spend will need a PO plus a 30-day lead time for vendor setup. Anything above $50k/month requires legal review and a vendor security checklist (SOC2).

Next steps (can we confirm these by EOD Tue?):
- You: confirm steady-state monthly token estimate (low/likely/high) — Kai / Sasha
- Us: send a pilot pricing worksheet with scenarios at $25/$32/$38 per 1M tokens, and the procurement checklist + recommended PO thresholds — Vivek/Rishi

I've attached a quick pricing sheet that models the three unit-econ scenarios and shows monthly spend at different token volumes. If helpful, we can render the same as an expected monthly burn by feature.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot-pricing-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Kai Chen <kai@averylabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sasha Lim <sasha@averylabs.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot consumption 'gamma' — quick post-call recap + ask

Vivek — thanks, this is helpful. Couple clarifications from our side: 

- The 12–18M tokens/month is our mid estimate for the pilot after week 3. Low/high bounds would be 6M / 25M to account for optimistic/worst-case user engagement.
- Finance asked that we define an internal acceptance criterion: if the pilot's average cost > $40 / 1M tokens at steady state, we pause expansion. That doesn't change the procurement gate, but it does influence which unit-econ scenario we prefer.

We'll confirm by Tuesday end of day. Also — can you call out what the PO threshold looks like for a 3-month pilot total vs monthly commit? Procurement tends to prefer a single PO for the pilot term if the monthly expected > $20k.

-Kai
Head of Product | Avery Labs
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Chen <kai@averylabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot consumption 'gamma' — procurement thresholds + PO guidance

Kai — looping in procurement guidance from our side so you can share with finance / ops. Summary below is our standard practice for pilots and the recommended options given the token ranges you provided: 

Recommended procurement lanes (pilot-specific):
- Expected monthly <= $10k: month-to-month card billing (fastest, no PO).
- Expected monthly $10k - $30k: single PO for 3-month pilot (preferred by procurement to bundle invoicing).
- Expected monthly $30k - $60k: PO + 30-day vendor onboarding; finance will typically ask for an estimated SOW and sign-off.
- Expected monthly > $60k: requires legal review + security questionnaire (SOC2) before execution.

Unit-econ scenarios (illustrative):
- Aggressive: $25 / 1M tokens -> 12M tokens/month = $300/month? (typo: meant $300? Wait correct calculation below)
- Conservative: $38 / 1M tokens -> 12M tokens/month = $456

Apologies — quick mental math mix. Attached is a corrected table in procurement-playbook.pdf with accurate monthly spend rows for 6M / 12M / 18M / 25M tokens at $25/$32/$38 per 1M tokens and the corresponding PO recommendation.

To be explicit on the PO timing you asked about: procurement prefers a single PO covering the 3-month pilot if the expected monthly spend is >= $20k (so 3-month aggregate >= $60k). If monthly is between $10k–$20k, procurement will accept a monthly invoicing cadence with a 1–2 week onboarding timeline.

If you want, we can draft the PO language that lists pilot scope, expected token caps, and an early-exit clause tied to the acceptance criterion Kai mentioned.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement-playbook.pdf (PDF)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Pilot consumption 'gamma' — confirmation & next steps

Thanks all — Kai, appreciate the low/likely/high bands (6M / 12–18M / 25M). I've attached a slimmed-down pricing extract for the three unit-econ targets you flagged ($25/$32/$38 per 1M tokens) with the monthly spend at each band — see table excerpt below: 

- 6M tokens/month -> $150 (at $25/1M) | $192 (at $32/1M) | $228 (at $38/1M)
- 12M tokens/month -> $300 | $384 | $456
- 18M tokens/month -> $450 | $576 | $684
- 25M tokens/month -> $625 | $800 | $950

Quick notes: the numbers above are for inference usage only (no managed labeling or fine-tune credits). For the pilot we can provide a one-time onboarding credit (discount) to nudge initial $/1M closer to the $32 bucket if you need it to satisfy finance acceptance.

Immediate next steps: 
- Kai/Sasha: confirm which unit-econ target you want modeled ($25/$32/$38) and whether finance wants a single 3-month PO or monthly invoicing — by Tue EOD.
- Marissa/Rishi: if Kai indicates PO path, draft PO language and send a preview to Avery Labs procurement.

I'll stand by for the confirmation and will prepare the one-page PO draft if you go the 3-month route.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
